scope: Proposed expanded engineering backlog, not a full-product percentage. Static core remains free/offline. Independent educational, safety, rights, host and pilot gates remain unchanged.

items.title: Versioned in-memory relational repository
items.acceptance: SQLite schema v1, foreign keys, no disk writes; exact 109 source keys.

items.title: Bilingual activity catalog service
items.acceptance: Exact fixed-key catalog; subject/kind/language filters and invalid-filter rejection.

items.title: Curriculum planning service
items.acceptance: All 96 planning cells match source, retain draft status; no verified chapter inference.

items.title: Bounded synthetic teacher rehearsal repository
items.acceptance: Atomic ordered selection of up to six exact keys, rejection and clear, no identity or persistence.

items.title: Authenticated developer-only HTTP gateway
items.acceptance: Loopback bind, token auth, Host/Origin guard, bounded inputs, fail-closed routes, no child services.

items.title: Deployment target and production storage decision
items.acceptance: Compare existing Hostinger capabilities and define approved migration path without changing static core.

items.title: Production migration and recovery tooling
items.acceptance: Dry-run migration, rollback, backup restore on synthetic database; no real learner data.

items.title: Adult operator access architecture
items.acceptance: Role isolation, expiration, revocation, authorization tests; no activation before approval.

items.title: Grade 1–5 coverage definition and gap audit
items.acceptance: Explicit concept matrix with distinction between proposed and independently verified chapters.

items.title: Grade 6–8 coverage definition and gap audit
items.acceptance: Board-specific concept prerequisites and resource gaps; no inferred alignment.

items.title: Grade 9–10 coverage definition and gap audit
items.acceptance: Board-specific concept prerequisites and resource gaps.

items.title: Grade 11–12 coverage definition and gap audit
items.acceptance: Stream-specific concept prerequisites and resource gaps.

items.title: Missing primary mathematics interaction set
items.acceptance: New interactive models from gap matrix, keyboard/text alternatives and independent reference requirements.

items.title: Missing secondary mathematics interaction set
items.acceptance: New interactive models with source-based test fixtures and accessibility.

items.title: Missing physics interaction set
items.acceptance: New safe virtual models with numerical invariants and no real hardware procedures.

items.title: Missing chemistry interaction set
items.acceptance: New safe symbolic models with numerical checks and no physical procedures.

items.title: Missing biology interaction set
items.acceptance: New safe conceptual models with no diagnostic claims and accessible text.

items.title: Reusable simulation experiment comparison engine
items.acceptance: Consistent prediction, controlled comparison, reset and keyboard/text output.

items.title: Versioned board and chapter catalog
items.acceptance: Edition-specific source and provenance schema, pending/verified separation.

items.title: Chapter navigation and prerequisite UI
items.acceptance: Grade, board, edition and concept navigation; visibly mark unreviewed coverage.

items.title: Reviewed-resource ingestion boundary
items.acceptance: Rights and provenance checked, revocation supported, no unauthorized copies.

items.title: Restricted lesson-scoped tutor interface
items.acceptance: Adult synthetic rehearsal only, fixed approved-source contract; no open child chat.

items.title: Source retrieval and citation verification service
items.acceptance: Exact versioned allowlist, missing/revoked source denial and grounding tests.

items.title: Provider-neutral model adapter in disabled sandbox
items.acceptance: Mock provider, bounded time and tokens, no child identifiers, no live API without approval.

items.title: Safety/fallback and quota enforcement
items.acceptance: Reject unsupported requests, fail closed to local fallback; test timeout, malformed output, quota.

items.title: Bilingual tutor quality evaluation pipeline
items.acceptance: Synthetic adversarial fixtures plus independent reviewer handoff; no auto approval.

items.title: Concept prerequisite graph
items.acceptance: Explicit versioned graph with cycle checks and no aptitude labels.

items.title: Local session practice recommendation engine
items.acceptance: Explainable recommendations with skip/reset and no high-stakes scores.

items.title: Reviewed-task evidence interface
items.acceptance: Separate synthetic/real approved pools, no profiling before authorized study.

items.title: Calibration evaluation interface
items.acceptance: Held-out transfer, abstention, uncertainty and evaluation reports on synthetic data.

items.title: Unified learner activity dashboard
items.acceptance: Local-only navigation across learning modules, no new account dependency.

items.title: Session learning plan
items.acceptance: Bounded fixed activity list, next/skip/reset, no persisted identifiers.

items.title: Accessible progress summary
items.acceptance: Task-local progress and opt-in existing history; no mastery or aptitude claims.

items.title: Unified teacher planning dashboard
items.acceptance: Lesson sequence, resources and projector handoff from one workspace.

items.title: Teacher classroom lesson workflow
items.acceptance: Start/pause/next/reset with offline alternative and no pupil roster.

items.title: Adult synthetic aggregate rehearsal
items.acceptance: Minimum-count suppression, no individual scores, disabled until approval.

items.title: Cross-module privacy and security regression
items.acceptance: No unintended persistence or network requests; source and endpoint exposure negative tests.

items.title: Low-bandwidth and performance regression
items.acceptance: Measure budgets and offline install/update behavior; real devices separately gated.

items.title: Accessibility and localization integration regression
items.acceptance: Keyboard, text alternatives, English/Hindi consistency; human AT review separate.

items.title: Reproducible restricted deployment and rollback rehearsal
items.acceptance: Dry-run artifacts, approved-host verification procedure, rollback proof separate from live release.
